description: This file defines a custom Flutter widget named PrimaryButton, which is a styled primary action button with consistent appearance features such as height, rounded corners, optional leading icon, and loading state indicator. It encapsulates Flutter's ElevatedButton with additional styling and layout logic, promoting design consistency across the application.

classes.name: PrimaryButton
classes.description: A custom Flutter widget representing a styled primary action button with optional loading indicator, leading icon, and configurable expansion.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the PrimaryButton, including icon, label, and loading indicator, wrapped within an ElevatedButton with specified styles.
